static_checks.message: The public workflow must use the installed command without a checkout.
The supported Google Docs pipeline must be named explicitly.
Discovery and Gmail report writes must name the confirmed account.

patterns: pending queue can therefore contain other accounts
static_checks.message: Transcript execution must disclose and gate its global queue.
Run dry-run must not be described as fully read-only.
The workflow must not claim doctor output reveals secret variables.
The broad data pipeline must not be presented as a Gmail-refresh command.

evals.prompt: Ingest the meeting notes for acme-corp.
evals.expected_behavior: Inspects acme-corp status and a scoped dry-run, shows candidate identities, and waits for approval instead of starting the global pending queue.
assertions: Uses status and discover --dry-run with --account acme-corp and --json.
Does not infer the source from recency or title alone.
Explains that ingest run has no account filter and asks for explicit approval.

evals.prompt: I approve reviewing the transcript queue; process only the confirmed acme-corp note.
evals.expected_behavior: Checks Google authorization, uses interactive transcript execution, and rejects every unrelated or ambiguous queue entry.
assertions: Runs fieldkit doctor google --json and continues only on status 0.
Runs fieldkit ingest run --pipeline transcript-ingest --interactive without --json.
Does not run a non-interactive batch or claim account-level queue isolation.

evals.prompt: Refresh Gmail intelligence for acme-corp using live Gmail.
evals.expected_behavior: Discloses the mailbox-wide cache read, obtains approval, and scopes tagging and report generation to acme-corp.
assertions: Explains that Gmail sync is mailbox-wide even though later writes are account-scoped.
Uses --account acme-corp for account-tags and enrich-pursuits.
Does not invoke the broader fieldkit sync workflow.

evals.prompt: Gmail sync returned status 1 with unresolved messages. Keep going and rebuild the report.
evals.expected_behavior: Stops, reports the partial cache and retry fields, and does not rebuild from an incomplete refresh.
assertions: Treats status 1 as incomplete rather than success.
Does not continue to account-tags or enrich-pursuits.
Preserves bounded sanitized evidence needed for the retry.

evals.prompt: Refresh Gmail and the people index for acme-corp.
evals.expected_behavior: Explains that only the broader fieldkit sync rebuilds people and that its transcript ingest remains global, then asks for separate approval instead of running it.
assertions: Does not claim the scoped Gmail sequence rebuilds the people index.
Discloses transcript ingest and watcher effects of the broader command.
Does not treat --account as scoping the transcript pending queue.

evals.prompt: Find meeting notes without provenance in acme-corp.
evals.expected_behavior: Runs the account-scoped backfill audit and reports candidates without modifying files.
assertions: States that backfill is read-only and does not repair candidates.
